row.body: The route map is folded around a weapon handover slip; the last stop is marked complete, but the return route has no driver.
row.title: The line ends here

sidecar.gloss: A handover is complete at the last stop, but no driver is listed for the return.
sidecar.rival_reading: A program crew could have stored security equipment at the end of a work route; the missing driver does not say why the trip ended.
